item.task: Tell me the price, the data and whether Acme Home Plus is available at Zeelaan 20.
item.golden: Acme Home Plus costs 34 USD a month and includes 60 GB. It is available at Zeelaan 20.
item.candidate_a: Thank you for asking about Acme Home Plus. We have looked at your question carefully. The plan costs 34 USD a month, which is the same price for every household in our area, and it gives you 60 GB of data each month so you can stream, work and play without worrying about limits. As for coverage, Acme Home Plus is not available at Zeelaan 20, and our installers can tell you more about the timing when you call us. We hope this helps and we are happy to answer any other question.
item.candidate_b: Acme Home Plus is 39 USD a month with 60 GB. It is not available at Zeelaan 20.
